title: config/duplication.json
description: The rule of the duplication check (duplication-check.mts, K248-3, K1104) that the repository declares: the jscpd formats it reads, the minimum lines of a piece, the ignore-patterns of lines that carry no logic, and the globs that it does not read, each with its reason. What is not declared is jscpd's own default.

formats.description: The jscpd formats that the check reads, such as typescript or php; without it, every format of jscpd.

minLines.description: The minimum lines of a piece that the check reports; without it, the default of jscpd.

ignorePatterns.description: The ignore-patterns of jscpd: regular expressions of lines that carry no logic, such as the file header of each format (K287). jscpd splits them at commas, so a pattern holds none.

glob.description: A glob of jscpd, relative to the root, such as tests/**.

reason.description: Why the folder is no component whose concerns the check separates.

exclude.description: The globs that the check does not read, each with its reason.
